analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($162.66) vs SMA5 ($131.33)/SMA20 ($130.12)/SMA50 ($130.99) — confirmed above short/mid-term trends.

· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.3823→2.0588) — continued improvement, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $147.50) — breaking upper band, in bullish expansion phase.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance ($163.70) — potential for further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day high ($164.51)/low ($119.62), 20-day high ($164.51)/low ($117.89) — Higher Low pattern confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (4.20x) — surge, increasing confidence in upward momentum.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) — five consecutive daily closes in the green, meeting buy entry conditions.
